How many programs are there in each busi:
```sql
SELECT business_unit, COUNT(*) AS program_count
FROM programs
GROUP BY business_unit;
```
What is the total approved budget per bu:
```sql
SELECT business_unit, SUM(budget_musd) AS total_budget_musd
FROM programs
GROUP BY business_unit;
```
Which program has the most S1 or S2 defe:
```sql
SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS open_severe_defects
FROM defects d
JOIN programs p ON d.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE d.severity IN ('S1', 'S2') AND d.status != 'closed'
GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name
ORDER BY open_severe_defects DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
What is the average build duration in mi:
```sql
SELECT branch, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_duration_min
FROM builds
GROUP BY branch;
```
For each business unit, what percentage:
```sql
SELECT p.business_unit,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS failure_pct
FROM builds b
JOIN programs p ON b.program_id = p.program_id
GROUP BY p.business_unit;
```
List the defect id and severity of defec:
```sql
SELECT d.defect_id, d.severity
FROM defects d
JOIN programs p ON d.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE p.business_unit = 'Automotive'
  AND d.opened_at >= '2026-09-01' AND d.opened_at < '2026-10-01';
```
What is the average number of days it ta:
```sql
SELECT severity,
       ROUND(AVG(julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)), 1) AS avg_days_to_close
FROM defects
WHERE status = 'closed' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY severity;
```
Which components have more than 5 defect:
```sql
SELECT component
FROM defects
WHERE status = 'open'
GROUP BY component
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
```
For every program, how many of its miles:
```sql
SELECT p.name, COUNT(m.milestone_id) AS done_milestones
FROM programs p
LEFT JOIN milestones m ON m.program_id = p.program_id AND m.status = 'done'
GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name;
```
Which programs started in the second hal:
```sql
SELECT name FROM programs
WHERE start_date >= '2025-07-01' AND start_date < '2026-01-01';
```
Show the 3 longest builds: build id, pro:
```sql
SELECT b.build_id, p.name, b.duration_min
FROM builds b
JOIN programs p ON b.program_id = p.program_id
ORDER BY b.duration_min DESC, b.build_id ASC
LIMIT 3;
```
How many defects are not closed in each:
```sql
SELECT p.name, COUNT(d.defect_id) AS open_defects
FROM programs p
LEFT JOIN defects d ON d.program_id = p.program_id AND d.status != 'closed'
GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name;
```
Show the defect counts for the Camera pr:
```sql
SELECT p.name, COUNT(d.defect_id) AS defect_count
FROM programs p
JOIN defects d ON d.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE p.business_unit = 'Camera'
GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name;
```
What percentage of builds on the main br:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS failure_pct
FROM builds
WHERE branch = 'main';
```
How many people do we have by job title?:
```sql
SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM employees
GROUP BY title
ORDER BY headcount DESC;
```
What is the build pass rate on the relea:
```sql
SELECT p.name,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_rate_pct
FROM builds b
JOIN programs p ON b.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE b.branch = 'release'
GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name;
```
